descriptionChirho: A major Canaanite city that became a Levitical city in the territory of Benjamin, identified with modern el-Jib northwest of Jerusalem. Prominently featured in Joshua 9:3-17 (Gibeonite treaty with Israel), Joshua 10:1-12 (the battle where the sun stood still), Joshua 11:19 and 18:25 (city lists), Joshua 21:17 (Levitical allocation), 2 Samuel 2:12-16 (the pool of Gibeon combat), 2 Samuel 20:8 (Amasa's assassination), 1 Kings 3:4-5 and 9:2 (Solomon's sacrifice and dream at the great high place), 1 Chronicles 8:29, 9:35, 14:16, 16:39, 21:29 (genealogies and tabernacle location), 2 Chronicles 1:3, 1:13 (Solomon at Gibeon), Isaiah 28:21, Jeremiah 28:1 and 41:12, 41:16. The directional form gibeonah appears in 2 Sam 2:12 and 1 Kgs 3:4. All multilingual glosses uniformly render the same toponym across prepositional contexts.
